title: 专业发展视频——让人们不断成长的发展投资
description: According to LinkedIn Learning's 2024 Workplace Learning Report, 94% of employees say they would stay at a company longer if it invested in their career development — but only 34% of L&D professionals say their organization has a clear professional development strategy, and even fewer have the video content library to deliver one at scale. According to the same report, the skills employees most want to develop — communication, leadership, project management, data literacy, and strategic thinking — are exactly the skills that traditional classroom training delivers least effectively, because they require repeated exposure, real-world modeling, and the ability to revisit the material at the moment of application. According to Gallup's 2023 State of the Global Workplace, employees who feel their organization is investing in their development are 3.6x more likely to be engaged — and disengaged employees cost organizations an average of $3,400 for every $10,000 in salary in lost productivity. Professional Development Video creates the video content infrastructure that lets organizations close the gap between what their employees want and what their L&D calendar can actually deliver: career pathing and growth roadmap videos that show employees the concrete skills, experiences, and milestones associated with advancement in their role family — so they can see where they're going and what preparing for it actually looks like, skill-building module videos covering the high-demand competencies that employees want most: analytical thinking, executive communication, stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and the technical skills specific to their role and industry, mentorship and career conversation videos that prepare both mentors and mentees for the structured development conversations that create the relationship ROI organizations want from their mentoring programs, conference and learning recap videos capturing the key insights from external training investments so the entire team benefits from the one person who attended the summit, and high-potential development track videos designed for the emerging leaders an organization is investing in specifically — with content depth and challenge calibrated to someone who is ready for more than their current role requires. Professional Development Video exports structured development libraries for individual contributor tracks, manager development programs, high-potential cohorts, and organization-wide upskilling initiatives. HR business partners building development programs without dedicated instructional design teams, L&D specialists scaling professional development beyond what the training calendar can hold, talent management leaders building the retention infrastructure that competes with external recruiters, and managers who want to invest in their team but need content to do it with all use Professional Development Video to deliver the career investment that keeps good people growing instead of leaving.
